data.name: Casa da Companhia Hotel & Spa, Vignette Collection by IHG
data.hotelDescription:
Luxurious Accommodation
Casa da Companhia Hotel, Vignette Collection is a 5-star hotel in the heart of Porto, offering elegantly furnished air-conditioned rooms with modern amenities like a coffee machine, minibar, and flat-screen TV. Some rooms even feature a balcony for stunning views of the city.

Relaxation and Wellness
Indulge in ultimate relaxation at the hotel's spa and wellness centre, complete with outdoor and indoor swimming pools, a fitness centre, and a sauna. Unwind in the hammam after a day of exploring the city.

Dining and Entertainment
Start your day with a delicious continental breakfast and later dine at the hotel's restaurant or enjoy a drink at the bar. With a terrace overlooking the city, Casa da Companhia Hotel, Vignette Collection offers a perfect setting for a memorable stay.

Book now for a luxurious and rejuvenating experience at Casa da Companhia Hotel, Vignette Collection in Porto.

Some guests found food/drinks mediocre for the price
Beds described as a bit too firm by one guest
pros: Spacious, breathtaking rooms with comfortable beds and modern controls
Friendly and helpful staff (upgrades, arrival tours)
Strong amenities: indoor pool, outdoor pool, steam room and sauna
Excellent breakfast with à la carte and buffet options

categories.name: Cleanliness
categories.description: Multiple reviewers call the hotel 'beautiful' and 'Top in jeder Hinsicht' and praise the preserved heritage and facilities, indicating excellent cleanliness and upkeep.

categories.name: Service
categories.description: Mixed reports: several guests praise friendly, helpful staff, upgrades and guided arrival tours, but a severe negative incident (last-minute booking cancellation and a rude manager) reduces consistency of service.

categories.name: Location
categories.description: Repeatedly described as 'perfect', 'awesome', and on a great shopping street with bars and restaurants — clearly a standout strength.

categories.name: Room Quality
categories.description: Rooms described as spacious, breathtaking, very comfortable beds (electronic lights/curtains, attractive lighting and plant displays) — consistently high praise for room quality.

categories.name: Amenities
categories.description: Multiple mentions of indoor pool, steam room, sauna and outdoor pool plus well-preserved heritage facilities — amenities are highlighted as excellent.

categories.name: Value for Money
categories.description: Mixed: excellent breakfast and strong facilities support value, but the last-minute cancellation (financial cost) and a comment that some food is 'so so for the price' lower perceived value.

categories.name: Food and Beverage
categories.description: Breakfast described as 'amazing and tasty' with both à la carte and buffet options; while one guest called some food 'so so for the price', overall breakfast and F&B receive very strong praise.

categories.name: Overall Experience
categories.description: Majority of guests report outstanding, even breathtaking stays with great staff and facilities, but the extremely negative experience of a last-minute cancelled, fully-paid booking and poor handling by management lowers the overall experience score.
